title: Ruby-forming mineral found by Mars rover hints at violent impacts
source: Space News - Space, Astronomy, Space Exploration
summary: So far, most of the minerals found on Mars tell a story of lava poured out by ancient volcanoes, followed by long stretches in which water trickled through and slowly reshaped the rock.
